title: Vietnamese Spring Rolls (Gỏi Cuốn)
description: A classic Vietnamese dish made with fresh vegetables and herbs served with a sweet and spicy dipping sauce.

ingredients.name: herbs
ingredients.notes: such as mint, basil, and cilantro

instructions: Prepare the rice paper wrappers according to package instructions.
Cut the cabbage into thin strips and set aside.
Cook the shrimp until pink and set aside.
Cook the rice noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
Assemble the spring rolls by placing a small amount of noodles, shrimp, and cabbage onto a rice paper wrapper.
Add a few herbs on top of the filling and roll up the wrapper tightly.
Serve the spring rolls with peanut sauce and hummus for dipping.
Optional: Fry the spring rolls in hot oil until crispy and serve as an appetizer.
